description: Relevant but generic answers, some 'we', few specifics or results.

messages.text: I'm a recent CS graduate. I did an internship at Zeta where I worked on backend stuff in Go, and I like building APIs and learning new things.
Tell me about a conflict in a team.
In a college project two of us disagreed on the database. We discussed it and in the end we went with Postgres because more people knew it. It worked out fine.
Once a migration I wrote caused a problem in production. We rolled it back and fixed it. I learned to be more careful with migrations.
Tell me about a time you took ownership.
We had some outdated documentation, so our team updated it. I helped write a few pages and people found it useful.
I like solving problems and working with good people, and payments seems interesting because it's important.
Thanks, that's all from me. The team will be in touch.
